title: Map who depends on you and plan breaking changes
summary: Other teams build on your platform, so a change you make can break their work. Know who uses what, and give them time and help when something must change.

beginner: List the teams and systems that use your platform.
For each, note which parts they use.
Learn the difference between a compatible change and a breaking change.
Before a breaking change, tell every affected team and agree a date.
Give them a guide to move to the new version.
intermediate: Keep a live map of consumers and the features they use.
Use clear version numbers so teams can tell what is safe to upgrade.
Set a deprecation policy: notice period, support window and removal date.
experienced: Set versioning and deprecation standards across platforms.
Measure the cost of breaking changes to other teams.
Plan migrations as a portfolio, not one team at a time.

canDelegateTo.task: Find which teams call which features

toolExamples.confluence: Publish the consumer map and deprecation policy.
toolExamples.github: Tag releases with semantic version numbers.

definitionOfDone: Next breaking change agreed with affected teams
pitfalls: Assuming nobody uses an old feature
